name: report_compliance_findings
description: CRITICAL: Call this tool ONLY when you have finished evaluating ALL compliance rules against the workspace code. Report every violation found. If no violations were found, report passed=true with an empty violations list. This tool ends the compliance check.

passed.description: true if all compliance rules are satisfied, false if any violation was found.

violations.description: List of compliance violations found. Empty array if passed is true.

rule_id.description: Stable identifier of the rule that was broken.

resource.description: Terraform resource address that violates the rule (e.g. azurerm_storage_account.main), or null for global findings.

message.description: Human-readable explanation of what is wrong and why it violates the rule.

suggested_fix.description: How to fix the violation, or null if no specific fix is suggested.

summary.description: Human-readable summary of the compliance check results.

checked_rules.description: List of rule_ids that were evaluated during the check.
